errors.text: The proposed Si addition and aging treatment do not reconstruct the Cr-alloying intervention or the as-cast Cr-containing Laves phase.
The baseline room-temperature fracture strain is incorrectly characterized as negligible or below 1%, whereas the target baseline is approximately 11.6% in compression.
The falsification experiment does not isolate solid-solution hardening from the phase-network mechanism because Si concentration, solute content, and silicide fraction all change together.

The predicted ductility benefit of a reticulated silicide network is not supported by the cited evidence; the evidence only provides generic precipitation results or examples involving Laves/B2 phases.
The density prediction is poorly justified and has the wrong qualitative framing for adding a very low-atomic-mass element to this dense refractory alloy.
